Former W.H. Sammis Plant data center
status_detail: ETEM's official site says it acquired the W.H. Sammis Plant in 2023, has substantially remediated the site, and is developing an energy and data center campus at Ohio-7 in Stratton. ETEM FAQ says Sammis and Hollow Rock are planned as an energy generation and data center campus with existing 138kV/345kV substations, fiber engagement with Zayo/Comcast/Lumen, and demolition/remediation completion targeted for Q4 2026. Local reporting from a Jefferson County commissioners meeting described ETEM seeking Priority Investment Area designation and discussed roughly 500 MW data-center power needs.
notes: Capacity entered as 500 MW from local report of ETEM's commissioners presentation; ETEM official materials emphasize available substation capacity and data-center redevelopment but do not publish a final IT-load figure.
